question: Between Willie Rechert and Laughton Antonio, which learner is more satisfied with the module Machine Learning Theory?
evidence: score refers to learner's satisfaction degree with the module; more satisfied refers to MAX(score);

candidates.label: A
candidates.sql: SELECT t1.given FROM learner AS t1 INNER JOIN enrollment AS t2 ON t1.learner_id = t2.learner_id INNER JOIN module AS t3 ON t2.module_id = t3.module_id WHERE t1.family = 'Rechert' AND t1.given = 'Willie' AND t3.title = 'Machine Learning Theory' ORDER BY t2.score DESC LIMIT 1

candidates.label: B
candidates.sql: SELECT t1.learner_id FROM enrollment AS t1 INNER JOIN learner AS t2 ON t1.learner_id = t2.learner_id INNER JOIN module AS t3 ON t1.module_id = t3.module_id WHERE t2.given = 'Willie' AND t3.title = 'Machine Learning Theory' ORDER BY t1.score DESC LIMIT 1

candidates.label: C
candidates.sql: SELECT t1.given, t1.family FROM learner AS t1 INNER JOIN enrollment AS t2 ON t1.learner_id = t2.learner_id INNER JOIN module AS t3 ON t2.module_id = t3.module_id WHERE t1.given = 'Willie' AND t3.title = 'Machine Learning Theory' ORDER BY t2.score DESC LIMIT 1
